page.title: PhD Paper Reviewer
page.caption: Choose agents, set review rounds, and run the reviewer from your browser. Hover over the ? icons for details.

model.label: Model
model.help: The LLM used for the review agents. Keep your Grok model here unless you intentionally want to test a different provider or model.

rounds.label: Review rounds
rounds.help: How many times the enabled agents revisit the document. More rounds usually improve quality but increase runtime and cost.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Choose whether the tool writes tracked changes plus comments, or comments only. Comments-only is safer when you want maximum human control.

vision.label: Enable figure vision
vision.help: Lets the app inspect supported embedded figures. This can be slower and only works for image formats the model can read.

editing_aggressiveness.label: Editing aggressiveness
editing_aggressiveness.help: Controls how strongly the text-editing agents rewrite prose. Conservative keeps wording closer to the original, while substantive allows broader rewrites.

crossref_mailto.label: Crossref polite email
crossref_mailto.help: Optional email address sent with Crossref lookups. This is recommended when doing heavier metadata verification because it helps identify polite API use.

unpaywall_email.label: Unpaywall email
unpaywall_email.help: Optional email used for open-access paper lookup. Add this if you want the app to try finding openly available full text for fact-checking.

author.label: Tracked changes author
author.help: Name that will appear in the Word tracked changes and comments.

upload.label: Upload a .docx file
upload.help: Upload the Word document you want reviewed. The original file is not modified; the app produces a reviewed copy.

output_name.label: Output filename
output_name.help: Name of the reviewed Word file you will download.

run_review.label: Run review
run_review.help: Starts the selected review pipeline using the uploaded document and current settings.

download_docx.label: Download reviewed DOCX
download_docx.help: Download the reviewed Word file with tracked changes and comments.

download_decisions.label: Download decisions JSON
download_decisions.help: Download the structured review decisions generated by the agents. Useful for debugging or later analysis.

download_log.label: Download log file
download_log.help: Download the runtime log with warnings, retries, and progress details.

agent_group_caption.help: Agent speeds are approximate: fast < medium < slow. Actual runtime depends on document length and the number of cited references.

max_workers.label: Parallel workers
max_workers.help: How many review tasks run in parallel. Higher values can speed up runs but may increase API load.

overall_review_agent.label: Overall review agent
overall_review_agent.help: Reviews the paper at a high level for structure, argument flow, section balance, and major logical weaknesses.

grammar_agent.label: Grammar agent
grammar_agent.help: Improves grammar, clarity, concision, and academic tone. Minor language fixes are usually better handled here as tracked changes without extra comments.

science_agent.label: Science agent
science_agent.help: Checks scientific wording, mechanistic accuracy, overclaims, and discipline-specific phrasing.

methods_agent.label: Methods agent
methods_agent.help: Reviews the methods section for reproducibility, technical completeness, and procedural clarity. This is most useful for original research papers.

results_agent.label: Results agent
results_agent.help: Reviews the results section for interpretation, overstatement, figure linkage, and internal consistency. This is most useful for original research papers.

citation_style_agent.label: Citation style agent
citation_style_agent.help: Cleans citation and reference formatting, spacing, and obvious style issues. Minor reference hygiene issues should mostly be corrected directly in tracked changes.

literature_review_agent.label: Literature review agent
literature_review_agent.help: Reviews synthesis quality, comparison of sources, thematic flow, and whether a review paper critically evaluates the literature rather than only summarizing it.

fact_check_agent.label: Fact-check agent
fact_check_agent.help: Checks whether claims are supported by cited literature metadata, abstracts, and open-access full text when available.

reference_verification.label: Reference verification
reference_verification.help: Runs deterministic reference matching and metadata checks, such as DOI verification, year mismatches, and other bibliographic issues.

messages.running: Running review... slower agents such as Fact Check and Citation Cleanup can take several minutes on long papers.
messages.vision_note: Figure vision works best with PNG/JPEG/WebP images. Some embedded Word objects may still be skipped if they are not real images.
